evidence: Si(100) wafers with 210 nm of thermally grown SiO 2 were coated with NiO in a Savannah S100 ALD equipment from Ultratech operated at 200 ºC in stop/exposure -mode. The pulse times of nickelocene and ozone in the NiCp 2/O3 cycle were 4 s and 0.2 s, respectively; the exposure and pump times were 10 s and 30 s, respectively.
